args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api: current version `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Identified** the most recent healthy production release as `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy; v2.3.1-rc was an unhealthy staging build).

3. **Rolled back** checkout-api to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — verified successful.

4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.
